title: Crit Club (Ages 18+)
description: Image caption: Local artist and teacher Nancy Newman sharing her watercolor painting to student artists Crit Club (Ages 18+) Saturday, November 8 | 9 – 11 am Art Activity Room (Level B1), 50 Victoria Street Recognizing the value that critique plays in the development of artistic practice, Crit Club offers a free space for artists to gather and engage in thoughtful dialogue surrounding their own and each other’s artwork. To participate, attendees must bring finished works or works-in-progress, along with a willingness to receive and provide constructive criticism. This program occurs quarterly and is open to artists at all disciplines and career levels. Experience in art criticism is not required. All mediums and practices of art are welcome. Easels and table spaces provided. Any additional means of presentation responsible of the artist. Registration required at: AuroraCulturalCentre.ca/events-for-artists
